I replied in #coastal-team, in Bettina's thread, saying I haven't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest.

I haven't verified whether a scheduled job can post to this Slack workspace, so I left it unscheduled rather than promise it. The reply offers a manual digest on request. It also notes that money terms on open customer items need Anselm Grieve's or June Osei-Lark's approval before they go in a channel post.
